caption:
Sore back and a cart full of gadgets? Here's how to keep them in perspective.

Many people find a massage gun eases tightness for a while. Keep it on muscle, start low and avoid the front of the neck. Inversion tables aren't suitable for everyone: blood pressure, eye or heart conditions and pregnancy are reasons to check with your GP first. A posture brace is a short reminder, not all-day wear.

No gadget replaces regular walking, strength work and staying active.

Leg numbness or weakness, pain building over weeks, or bladder or bowel changes need a proper assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can talk through what you use at home. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
